compatibility_fix.repair: Whole-second timezone parsed by datetime; original fractional digits parsed as integer nanoseconds; all closure and cost rules unchanged

v4_resources.explanation: Quota core seconds are capacity exposure, not CPU consumption. GPU reservation means individually device-bound policy residence, not GPU busy time or the longer coordinator GPU-lock interval. Exact lock acquire/release timestamps are unavailable. Open residence is unknown, not zero.
